body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fixes a LookupField UX bug where selecting records via the Level 2 `RecordPickerDialog` updates the underlying value but doesn’t update the LookupField’s visible label/badges, by returning full record objects from the picker and caching them for display.

**Changes:**
- Added optional `onSelectRecords(records)` callback to `RecordPickerDialog` and a `selectedRecordsMap` cache to retain selected record objects across paging (multi-select).
- Added `pickerResolvedRecords` cache in `LookupField` and updated `findOption` to also resolve display data from dialog-selected records.
- Added tests for `onSelectRecords` behavior and for LookupField badge rendering after Level 2 selection; updated CHANGELOG.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 4 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/fields/src/widgets/RecordPickerDialog.tsx | Adds `onSelectRecords` callback and caches selected record objects for multi-select paging. |
| packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx | Caches dialog-selected records and extends option resolution to show badges/labels after dialog selection. |
| packages/fields/src/record-picker.test.tsx | Adds tests for `onSelectRecords` and end-to-end LookupField display after dialog selection. |
| CHANGELOG.md | Documents the LookupField selection display fix and the new callback. |

`handlePickerSelectRecords` replaces `pickerResolvedRecords` with only the records passed from the dialog. If `onSelectRecords` returns a partial set (e.g., only newly toggled records in multi-select), this can drop previously cached selected records and make badges/labels disappear for still-selected IDs that aren’t in `staticOptions`/`fetchedOptions`. Consider merging into the existing cache keyed by `value` (and optionally pruning entries not in the current `value`) instead of overwriting the entire array.

The new tests cover the basic `onSelectRecords` happy paths, but they don’t cover the edge case where the dialog opens with pre-selected values (via `value`) and the user confirms without toggling those rows. With the current implementation this can cause `onSelectRecords` to be called with an incomplete array. Adding a regression test for that scenario (and/or a multi-session multi-select case) would help prevent this from reappearing.

`onSelectRecords` is documented as returning the full record objects corresponding to the selected IDs, but in multi-select it only returns records present in `selectedRecordsMap`. Since the map is only populated when a row is toggled during the current session, any pre-selected IDs (from `value`) or selections that were never toggled can be missing, causing `onSelectRecords` to receive an incomplete array (sometimes even `[]` when confirming without changes). Consider seeding/updating `selectedRecordsMap` when records are fetched (e.g., for any record whose id is in `pendingSelection`) and/or adjusting the callback contract to include IDs or clarify that it may be partial.
